identitySignals: The agenda name combines two separate organizations: Northern California ReLiEF (a school-district excess liability joint powers authority) and PRISM (Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management, formerly CSAC Excess Insurance Authority).
The agenda gives no city or state.
The OUSD item is for excess workers' compensation and excess property and liability premiums. That fits both bodies, so it does not tell me which one a single profile should describe.
research.notes: The vendor field names two distinct public risk-pool joint powers authorities. PRISM has its own website (prismrisk.gov) and a Folsom, CA address. Northern California ReLiEF, formally the Northern California Regional Liability Excess Fund, is a separate pool for school and community college districts, and I found no official site for it in light research. One 'About this vendor' box would describe only one of them or mix the two, so I did not build a profile. A reviewer should split this into two vendor entries, or pick one entity, and then research each separately.
